title: Isolated native private-via guard and inner-plane fill control

question_answered.positive: Yes in this exact isolated fixture. Correctly layer-mapped conservative rectangular guards kept the native saved inner GND fill at least 0.250000 mm from the complete 0.600/0.300 mm private-via copper shape in all 4 four-layer cases and all 8 six-layer cases.
question_answered.anchor: The synthetic unattached GND VIA at (120,120) mm collided with nonempty native fill on every exercised inner layer. This is a useful valid local filled-via contact and nonempty-plane geometry control; it does not by itself establish a pad-terminal-connected or nonfloating functional return network.
question_answered.nonprojection: A 0.020 x 0.020 mm native polygon witness at F-only R26.2 intersected fill on every inner layer, showing that the F-only private pad guard was not spuriously projected.
question_answered.negative: Omitting only eafa404c-be47-5f5c-8167-d39a967ba2e5's In3.Cu guard in the six-layer negative produced direct native fill contact there: intersection true and measured clearance 0.000000 mm. The other seven private-via/layer cases retained 0.250000 mm.
question_answered.scope_limit: This demonstrates native KiCad 10.0.6 behavior for the exact synthetic fixture and conservative rectangles. It is not exact-curved-guard, full-input, Quilter-import, product-plane, stackup, supplier, manufacturing, or routing acceptance.

geometry_metric.fill: ZONE.GetFilledPolysList(layer).CloneDropTriangulation(); the complete native saved polygon set, including holes, was used rather than zone outlines, centers, or bounding boxes.
geometry_metric.private_via: PCB_VIA.GetEffectiveShape(layer) for each complete 0.600 mm outer-copper shape; no drill, mask, or center-point credit.
geometry_metric.distance: Native SHAPE_POLY_SET.Collide monotonic boundary search to a one-internal-unit lower bound.
geometry_metric.threshold: No collision at 0.25 mm minus one internal unit (1 nm). The 1 nm is numerical control tolerance, not fabrication tolerance.
geometry_metric.guard: Each private-via guard is the 0.600 mm copper extent plus a 0.25 mm rectangular halo: [x-0.55,y-0.55,x+0.55,y+0.55] mm, all five restriction flags not_allowed.
geometry_metric.anchor: Native collision between each filled polygon set and the synthetic unattached GND VIA effective shape. This is a valid local filled-via attachment/nonempty-plane geometry control, while not proving grounding through a pad terminal or absence of floating copper in a functional return network.
geometry_metric.F_only_witness: Native collision between each filled polygon set and a 0.020 x 0.020 mm polygon centered on R26.2 at (86.4,111.192) mm.

root_review.observed_negative: Only the omitted eafa404c In3 guard permits local fill contact; the other seven cases remain separated.
reviewed: Executed native code equals the preserved snapshot; native result and supervision receipt hashes match.
Native saved polygon sets include holes and use complete via effective shapes, not center-only isolation samples.
Saved-file canonical comparison preserves all eight footprints, twelve pads, ten tracks and four base vias; the only new primitive is the diagnostic anchor.
Static saved layer IDs/order and the precise six-layer negative rule delta reconcile with the measured profiles.
Every measured inner fill has one island and contacts the separate anchor via. This is an observed local nonempty-fill control, not functional grounding or a generalized validator guarantee.
All five authoritative repository-package hashes independently match the expected values; recorded native/test/static child PIDs are absent.

acceptance_scope: Exact isolated local native plane-isolation behavior only; not a product board or general-purpose acceptance checker.
